title: Chemical composition, sources, and health risks assessment of PM10 and PM2.5-bound metals at an industrial site in Nigeria
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EA00045A, Paper

Tesleem O. Kolawole, Khanneh W. Fomba, Godwin C. Ezeh, Akinade S. Olatunji, Khaleel A. Ghazal, Falk Mothes, Hartmut Herrmann
The study measured air quality near metal recycling factories (MRFs), revealing elevated toxic elements (Pb, Cr, Cu, Mo, Ni, Zn) in PM10 and PM2.5. Lead (Pb) levels near MRFs may pose future health risks for children.
